title.orig: 冨嶽三十六景 礫川雪の旦
title.en: Morning after the Snow at Koishikawa in Edo
title.zh: 富岳三十六景 砾川雪之旦

medium.en: Woodblock print; ink and colour on paper

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1849. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1849 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: From the upper room of a teahouse on a snowy hill, a group of people look out across white rooftops toward Mount Fuji, small and snow-capped on the horizon, under a deep, graded blue sky.
alt.zh: 雪后的山坡上，一群人在茶屋的楼上向外望，越过白色的屋顶，望向远处地平线上小小的、积雪的富士山；天空是层层加深的蓝。

note.en: From Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji, the series that includes the Great Wave. Here the mountain is a small white shape far away, and the real subject is the moment after a snowfall when people go to the window to look. The blue is Prussian blue, then a newly imported pigment, which let Hokusai print skies this deep.
note.zh: 出自《富岳三十六景》，也就是收有《神奈川冲浪里》的那一组。这里富士山只是远处一小块白，真正的主题是一场雪之后，人们走到窗边去看的那一刻。那种蓝是普鲁士蓝，当时刚从海外传入的颜料，北斋因此能把天空印得这样深。
